name: Local Book Search
summary: Local Book Search: find books on online mirrors by title, author, or ISBN.
description: Search LibGen or Anna’s Archive with publication-year ordering. Returns metadata for the loaded results page; use --agent-output for fallback sources and opaque book IDs.

query.description: Search text: book title, author, or ISBN. Searches all columns (title, author, series, year, publisher, isbn), so 'title author' works well.

base_url.description: Optional book source base URL. Include the trailing slash.

format.description: Optional extension filter, lowercased and matched exactly against the Ext. column (e.g. epub, pdf, mobi, azw3, djvu). Empty (default) returns all formats.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 25 (one results page). Hard cap 100.

sort.description: Publication year: year_desc (newest), year_asc (oldest), or relevance. Unknown years sort last. LibGen sorts the loaded page; Anna uses server sorting.

mirror_urls.description: Comma-separated fallback source base URLs, tried in order with --agent-output; maximum three total attempts.

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts with --agent-output, including the first source. Get advances slow partner servers between attempts.

mirror_index.description: Get: slow partner link index, starting at zero. Agent output increments this on retries.

steps.name: Navigate to the book search homepage

inputs.script: if (document.querySelector('#ddg-captcha')) throw new Error('site_challenge: complete manual verification in the browser'); return {ready: true};

steps.name: Type the query into the search box
Wait for the search results navigation
Wait for file results or the empty-result counter

help.summary: Local Book Search: find books on online mirrors by title, author, or ISBN.

examples.description: Find epub editions of a title
examples.command: rzn-browser run book search --param query="Brave New World Huxley" --param format=epub
rzn-browser run book search --param query="Pride and Prejudice Austen" --param limit=5

returns: Object: { layout_ok, query, format, count, results: [{ title, author, publisher, year, language, pages, size, ext, md5, edition_url, file_url }] }. layout_ok=false means the book source layout is unsupported — try another base_url.
notes: Supports the LibGen table layout and Anna’s Archive result cards.
Anna’s Archive uses native publication-year sorting; LibGen sorts all loaded rows before applying limit.
Get navigates through source pages and only slow partner links; persistent verification needs human input.
Use --agent-output for at most three attempts; ordinary mode exposes mirror_index and base_url for explicit retries.
